create_Instances_with_fields: create an Instances object with image size and fields like boxes, masks, and labels
index_Instances_by_condition: index an Instances object to filter detections by confidence score or class label
concatenate_Instances_lists: concatenate multiple Instances objects from the same image into a single Instances object
move_Instances_to_device: move all tensor fields of an Instances object to a specified GPU or CPU device
check_Instances_field_exists: check whether a named field exists in an Instances object before accessing it
